mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recording_sessions ( account_id, original_file_name, storage_object_key, content_type, file_size, status ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{originalFileName}, #{storageObjectKey}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT recording_session_id AS recordingSessionId, account_id AS accountId, original_file_name AS originalFileName, storage_object_key AS storageObjectKey, content_type AS contentType, file_size AS fileSize, status, full_transcript AS fullTranscript, failure_reason AS failureReason FROM recording_sessions WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE recording_sessions SET status = #{status}, started_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'TRANSCRIBING' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE started_at END, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId}
UPDATE recording_sessions SET full_transcript = #{fullTranscript}, status = #{status}, ended_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId}
UPDATE recording_sessions SET status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, ended_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE recording_session_id = #{recordingSessionId}
